AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Vegetables? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Vegetables.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Vegetables.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Vegetables.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Vegetables.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.

17. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food Frying Frying? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food Frying Frying.

21. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

22. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
